conditional: Yellow fever certificate: Proof of vaccination against yellow fever is required for travellers aged 9 months or over arriving from countries with risk of yellow fever transmission and for travellers having transited for more than 12 hours through an airport of a country with risk of yellow fever transmission. Entry will be denied if a valid vaccination certificate cannot be provided
